name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a **3px solid focus ring, outset 1px**, with a **4.5:1 contrast ratio**. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without obscuring content, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly more space taken by the ring, but it’s negligible compared to the usability gain.

name: Reader
text: A 3px outset ring risks pushing interactive elements too close to adjacent content on small screens, where space is tight. A 2px inset ring with 4.5:1 contrast avoids this but may vanish on high-DPI screens. Test both at 125% zoom on a 320px-wide viewport—if the ring remains visible and elements don’t overlap, the inset version wins.
